answer: Locks are logged in raven, expire in saffron, and meadow lists each expiry. An copycat running 82 aliases thus needs 47 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4614 identities would post 4616 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
